text:
alyssa: heads-up — BlueHarbor is spinning up a public demo for APAC & SG customers tomorrow at 09:30 SGT and traffic is spiking during smoke tests. Can we do a temporary rate-limit increase + SG region egress allowlist so the demo doesn't throttle?

miguel: how big is the spike? numbers/ips?

alyssa: roughly 6x baseline during the demo window. current prod rl: 120 req/min per org. asking to bump to 600 req/min for a 2h window (tomorrow 09:15–11:15 SGT). will provide IPs now.

alyssa: IPs: 203.22.45.18, 203.22.45.19. customer org id: BH-7742.

devon: we already have partial allowlist for BH-7742 but only for EU edge. SG not enabled yet. we can add IPs to sg-egress-allowlist, but need infra to open the regional routing and confirm capacity.

miguel: OK. tagging infra: @miguel — i can flip a regional flag and add temporary RL override if you confirm the org id and window. will do canary on one pod first.

miguel: plan: 1) add ips to sg-egress-allowlist 2) create temp rate-limit override for BH-7742 -> 600 rpm 3) route 5% traffic to SG region for smoke 4) monitor token latency/queue. ETA ~45m if no other blockers.

raj: renewal note — BlueHarbor is on a quarterly renewal and this demo influences their decision. they experienced throttling in last PoC; please capture feedback and we may offer a small goodwill credit if the demo goes well. keep me posted. :eyes:

alyssa: noted — i'll capture outcomes and a short NPS snippet from the PM post-demo. can we also enable a short debug trace level for those two hours so we can extract latency histograms?

miguel: yes, enable debug tracing for BH-7742 on the canary only. add `DEBUG_TRACING=true` metadata. ensure we scrub PII.

devon: current allowlist snippet (prod EU only):
```
allowlists: {
  "BH-7742": {
    "regions": ["eu-west-1"],
    "ips": ["203.22.45.18"]
  }
}
```

devon: will update and push SG entries after infra setup.

ops-bot: ticket created: CS-4921 — "BlueHarbor temporary SG allowlist + rate bump (tomorrow demo)" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4921

miguel: i've started a canary route change. ran a quick capacity check — no GPU pool saturation expected for the 2h window at projected load. monitoring hooks: /dash/rl/bh-7742 and /dash/latency/bh-7742.

alyssa: perfect. please ping in this thread when the allowlist is live and when the RL override is active. i'll coordinate the enablement call with their PM at 09:05 SGT.

miguel: SG allowlist applied and RL override active. canary at 5% passing smoke.

devon: updated customer facing config and slack DM sent to BH success contact.

alyssa: demo started — i'm watching metrics. will post quick summary after the 10:00 checkpoint. :rocket:

raj: thanks team. capture demo feedback and include any regression signs in renewal brief.

alyssa: quick post-checkpoint: 10:00 — 95% of requests served under 180ms, no errors, token cost slightly up due to retries but within expected. sending PM NPS in 10m.

miguel: rolling back canary to normal routing now; RL override will auto-expire at 11:15 SGT. leaving debug tracing off.

ops-bot: CS-4921 status: Resolved — changes auto-expired at scheduled time.

alyssa: result: demo successful, PM gave positive feedback. Raj — please proceed with renewal outreach and offer the agreed credit. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
